title: Ligustrazine hydrochloride Prevents Ferroptosis by Activating the NRF2 Signaling Pathway in a High-Altitude Cerebral Edema Rat Model.
authors: Han, Yue; Li, Wenting; Duan, Huxinyue; Jia, Nan; Liu, Junling; Zhang, Hongying; Song, Wenqian; Li, Meihui; He, Yang; Wu, Chunjie; He, Yacong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究盐酸川芎嗪通过激活NRF2信号通路抑制铁死亡以保护高原脑水肿大鼠，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: High-altitude cerebral edema (HACE) is a disorder caused by low pressure and hypoxia at high altitudes. Nevertheless, as of now, there is still a scarcity of safe and effective prevention and treatment methods. The active component of Ligusticum Chuanxiong, namely Ligustrazine hydrochloride (LH), has shown potential in the prevention and treatment of HACE due to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective effects in nervous system disorders. Consequently, the potential protective effect of LH on HACE and its mechanism still need to be further explored. Prior to modeling, 90 male Sprague-Dawley rats were pretreated with different doses of drugs, including LH (100 mg/kg and 50 mg/kg), dexamethasone (4 mg/kg), and ML385 (30 mg/kg). Subsequently, the pretreated rats were placed in a low-pressure anoxic chamber simulating a plateau environment to establish the rat HACE model. The effects and mechanisms of LH on HACE rats were further elucidated through determination of brain water content, HE staining, ELISA, immunofluorescence, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, western blot, and other techniques. The results showed, first of all, that LH pretreatment can effectively reduce brain water content; down-regulate the expression of AQP4, HIF-1alpha, and VEGF proteins; and alleviate damage to brain tissue and nerve cells. Secondly, compared with the HACE group, LH pretreatment can significantly reduce MDA levels and increase GSH and SOD levels. Additionally, LH decreased the levels of inflammatory factors IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha; reduced total iron content in brain tissue; increased the expression of ferroptosis-related proteins such as SLC7A11, GPX4, and FTH1; and alleviated ferroptosis occurrence. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations show that LH has a strong binding affinity for NRF2 signaling. Western blot analysis further confirmed that LH promotes the translocation of NRF2 from the cytoplasm to the nucleus and activates the NRF2 signaling pathway to exert an antioxidant effect. The NRF2 inhibitor ML385 can reverse the anti-oxidative stress effect of LH and its protective effect on HACE rat brain tissue. In summary, LH may have a protective effect on HACE rats by activating the NRF2 signaling pathway, inhibiting ferroptosis, and resisting oxidative stress.
abstract_zh: 高原性脑水肿（HACE）是由高海拔地区的低气压和缺氧引起的一种疾病。然而，截至目前，仍缺乏安全有效的预防和治疗方法。川芎的活性成分——盐酸川芎嗪（LH），因其在神经系统疾病中的抗炎、抗氧化和神经保护作用，在HACE的预防和治疗中显示出潜力。因此，LH对HACE的潜在保护作用及其机制仍需进一步探索。在建模前，90只雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠接受了不同剂量的药物预处理，包括LH（100 mg/kg和50 mg/kg）、地塞米松（4 mg/kg）和ML385（30 mg/kg）。随后，将预处理后的大鼠置于模拟高原环境的低压缺氧舱中，以建立大鼠HACE模型。通过测定脑含水量、HE染色、ELISA、免疫荧光、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、Western blot等技术，进一步阐明LH对HACE大鼠的作用及机制。结果显示，首先，LH预处理能有效降低脑含水量；下调AQP4、HIF-1α和VEGF蛋白的表达；并减轻脑组织和神经细胞的损伤。其次，与HACE组相比，LH预处理能显著降低MDA水平，并增加GSH和SOD水平。此外，LH降低了炎症因子IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平；减少了脑组织中的总铁含量；增加了铁死亡相关蛋白如SLC7A11、GPX4和FTH1的表达；并缓解了铁死亡的发生。分子对接和分子动力学模拟显示，LH对NRF2信号具有强结合亲和力。Western blot分析进一步证实，LH促进NRF2从细胞质向细胞核的转位，并激活NRF2信号通路以发挥抗氧化作用。NRF2抑制剂ML385可以逆转LH的抗氧化应激作用及其对HACE大鼠脑组织的保护作用。总之，LH可能通过激活NRF2信号通路、抑制铁死亡和抵抗氧化应激，对HACE大鼠产生保护作用。
